  "equations": [
    "v(t_0) = \\text{slope of tangent line}",
    "\\bar{v} = \\frac{\\Delta x}{\\Delta t} = \\frac{x_f - x_i}{t_f - t_i}",
    "\\Delta t = t_6 - t_1",
    "\\Delta t = t_5 - t_2",
    "\\Delta t = t_4 - t_3",
    "\\Delta t \\to 0",
    "t = t_0"
  ]
}

{
  "has_visual": true,
  "description": "Two graphs of velocity versus time labeled (a) and (b). Graph (a) shows an inverted U-shaped velocity curve with time on the horizontal axis and velocity on the vertical axis. Secant lines corresponding to time intervals between t1 and t6, t2 and t5, and t3 and t4 are shown, along with a horizontal tangent line at the peak where velocity is maximum at time t0, having a slope of zero. Graph (b) shows a U-shaped velocity curve with secant lines and a horizontal tangent line at the minimum velocity point at time t0, with a slope of zero.",
  "equations": [
    "a(t_0) = \\text{slope of tangent line}",
    "\\bar{a} = \\frac{\\Delta v}{\\Delta t} = \\frac{v_f - v_i}{t_f - t_i}",
    "\\Delta t = t_6 - t_1",
    "\\Delta t = t_5 - t_2",
    "\\Delta t = t_4 - t_3",
    "\\Delta t \\to 0"
  ]
}

    "\\bar{v} = \\frac{v_0 + v}{2}",

{
  "has_visual": true,
  "description": "The slide contains three diagrams labeled (a), (b), and (c). Diagrams (a) and (b) show a block on a rough surface with four forces acting on it: an applied force vector F pointing right, a friction vector pointing left (labeled fs in (a) and fk in (b)), a normal force vector N pointing up, and a weight vector w pointing down. Diagram (a) shows impending motion with static friction, and diagram (b) shows the object moving to the right. Diagram (c) is a graph of frictional magnitude vertical axis versus applied force F horizontal axis, showing a linear increase in the static region up to a peak labeled fs,max = mu_s N, followed by a drop and slight fluctuations in the kinetic region where fk = mu_k N.",
  "equations": [
    "\\vec{f}",
    "\\vec{F}",
    "\\vec{N}",
    "\\vec{w}",
    "\\vec{f_s}",
    "\\vec{f_k}",
    "f_s = F",
    "f_{s,\\text{max}} = \\mu_s N",
    "f_k = \\mu_k N",
    "f_{s}(\\text{max}) > f_k",
    "\\mu_s > \\mu_k"
  ]
}

  "has_visual": true,
  "description": "Two graphs of F cos \\theta versus d. Graph (a) shows a constant force component F cos \\theta represented by a horizontal line, where the shaded rectangular area under the curve equals F cos \\theta \\times d = F d cos \\theta = work = W. Graph (b) shows a variable force component plotted as an upward-sloping curve, approximated by a series of vertical rectangular strips of width d_i, with total work represented as W = \\sum W_i = total area under curve, and an individual strip labeled W_i = (F \\cos \\theta)_{i(ave)} d_i.",
  "equations": [
    "F \\cos \\theta",
    "Area = F \\cos \\theta \\times d",
    "= Fd \\cos \\theta",
    "= work = W",
    "W = \\sum W_i = \\text{total area under curve}",
    "W_i = (F \\cos \\theta)_{i(ave)} d_i"
  ]
}
